snippet.title: EPIC CINEMATIC TRAILER: BOWLING CREW
snippet.description:
❗ Play now on Android and iOS https://bowlingcrew.onelink.me/ABFA/fbplay

HD trailer of Bowling Crew game is here!

Subscribe to stay up to date with the latest news of the best bowling mobile game. Give the video like and share your thoughts in the comments! 

Bowling Crew is a new multiplayer mobile game by Kitomy. Released in 2020, it already gained millions of players all over the world. Intuitive controls make throwing strikes a breeze. Line up your shot, pull back, and flick forward to chuck the ball once the swinging arrow points where you want to throw. Add some spin or keep it straight to sweep the pins with a satisfying smash. Bawl with your friends on one of the beautiful 3D Alleys.


FOLLOW BOWLING CREW ON OTHER SOCIAL MEDIA CHANNELS:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/bowlingcrewgame
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/BowlingCrew/


MAIN GAMEPLAY FEATURES:
• Real-time 1-on-1 challenges against opponents from around the world
• League competitions
• Atmospheric 3D locations
• More than 50 unique balls that will become your secret weapon
• New unexpected pin layouts
• Collection of exclusive items for customizing your profile. Express your personality and present yourself as a bowling professional!
• Daily challenges with obstacles and complicated layouts

Bowling Crew is right up your alley!


SUPPORT
Facing any problems? Contact us via the game app by going to Menu - Support.

Terms of Use: https://kitomy.net/terms_of_service
Privacy Policy: https://kitomy.net/privacy_policy
